style.clay: Soft 3D clay render, cute and friendly, matte finish with subtle fine film grain, rounded chunky shapes, soft studio key light from the top left, gentle ambient occlusion, warm pastel palette of cream, sage, peach, blush and lilac with small gold (#F4A31C) and deep navy (#0D3052) accents. Minimal composition, the subject centred with generous empty padding on every side, isolated on a flat seamless solid {bg} background that fills the whole frame edge to edge — no gradient, no floor line, no horizon, no vignette, no border. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark.
style.product: Clean e-commerce product photograph, the product centred with generous padding, soft even studio light, a very soft contact shadow, on a seamless pure white (#FFFFFF) background that fills the frame. Photorealistic, crisp, true colours. No text overlays, no watermark, no brand logos, no people.
style.cinematic: Cinematic lifestyle photograph, shot on a full-frame camera with a 35mm lens at f/2, natural golden-hour light, warm filmic colour grade with soft highlights and rich but natural skin tones, gentle film grain, shallow depth of field, authentic candid emotion, editorial quality like a premium travel brand campaign. Vertical 9:16 composition: the main subjects sit in the upper two thirds of the frame; the lower third is calmer, softer, out-of-focus foreground detail with no faces (text will be placed there). No text, no readable signage, no letters, no logos, no watermark.
